'''Cheryl Kallenbach''' is the wife of Decipher designer [[Chuck Kallenbach]].<ref name="stackpole">[http://www.stormwolf.com/essays/decipher.html Visiting Decipher], Michael A. Stackpole, stormwolf.com (September 2000 visit). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250608214406/http://www.stormwolf.com/essays/decipher.html Internet Archive]</ref> She playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules" /> The card name [[Chyler]] is an anagram of her name.<ref name="ana" /><ref name="encyc" /> [[Chall Bekan]] and [[Imperial Helmsman]] (Bachenhall) come from the Kallenbach family name.<ref name="ana" />

== At Decipher ==

In late September 2000 Decipher flew authors Michael A. Stackpole and Timothy Zahn to Norfolk for a photo shoot tied to [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]]. Stackpole wrote that "Tom and Chuck, along with their wives Kathy and Cheryl, took Tim and me to dinner" that evening. Those hosts were [[Tom Lischke]], [[Chuck Kallenbach]] and [[Kathy Lischke]].<ref name="stackpole" />

In November 2000 she played in an in-house [[Young Jedi]] sealed deck tournament at the Decipher office in Norfolk. The event used the new ''Duel of the Fates'' expansion, and [[Kevin Reitzel]] ran it. "Ten Decipherians participated" in the playtest room. She finished tenth with a Dark Side deck, and Chuck finished fourth.<ref name="yj-sealed">[http://www.decipher.com/newsflash/2000/11/111400storyA.html "Decipherians Roll Out New Young Jedi Cards In Friday Night Sealed Deck"], Kevin Reitzel, Decipher NewsFlash (14 November 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011118094338/http://www.decipher.com:80/newsflash/2000/11/111400storyA.html Internet Archive]</ref>
